summary: Bend Studio's wavefront screen-space contact shadows for Atom: a compute pass ray-marches the scene depth buffer toward the sun to produce a screen-space shadow mask, optionally combined into the directional-light visibility so the sun is darkened with no lighting-shader edits. Ports Bend Studio's Apache-2.0 reference implementation (Graham Aldridge). No hardware ray tracing required.
requirements: Requires an Atom pipeline exposing a scene depth buffer and a directional light. To darken the sun, the pipeline must expose the FullscreenShadowBuffer pipeline-global (desktop default).
